from __future__ import annotations

def fetch_prs(probes) -> list[dict]:
    """PRs into auto/integration (gh search, cached); head branch from the per-repo PR meta."""
    fields = (
        "repository,number,title,state,labels,url,closedAt,updatedAt,body,createdAt"
    )
    args = [
        "search",
        "prs",
        "--owner",
        "matteocervelli",
        "--base",
        "auto/integration",
        "--created",
        ">=2026-10-13",
        "--limit",
        "200",
        "--json",
        fields,
    ]
    prs = probes.gh_json(args, C.CACHE / "prs.json", 100) or []
    for p in prs:
        repo = p["repository"]["nameWithOwner"]
        meta = probes.pr_meta(short_repo(p["repository"]["name"])).get(p["number"], {})
        if meta.get("headRefName"):
            p["headRefName"] = meta["headRefName"]
            continue
        c = C.CACHE / f"pr-{repo.replace('/', '_')}-{p['number']}.json"
        head = probes.gh_json(
            ["pr", "view", str(p["number"]), "-R", repo, "--json", "headRefName"],
            c,
            10**9,
        )
        p["headRefName"] = (head or {}).get("headRefName", "")
    return prs


def fetch_proposals(probes) -> list[dict]:
    """Older open proposals must survive the ordinary recent-PR search window."""
    fields = (
        "repository,number,title,state,labels,url,closedAt,updatedAt,body,createdAt"
    )
    rows = probes.gh_json(
        [
            "search",
            "prs",
            "--owner",
            "matteocervelli",
            "--base",
            "auto/integration",
            "--state",
            "open",
            "--label",
            "health-proposal",
            "--limit",
            "200",
            "--json",
            fields,
        ],
        C.CACHE / "health-prs.json",
        100,
    )
    return [p for p in rows or [] if is_proposal(p)]


def card_sources(probes, projects: list[str]) -> list[dict]:
    """Feed real merged PRs into the existing card assembler, including main PRs."""
    probe = getattr(probes, "release_facts", None)
    result = []
    for repo in projects:
        facts = (probe(repo) if callable(probe) else {}) or {}
        for row in facts.get("prs", []):
            if (not isinstance(row, dict) or not isinstance(row.get("number"), int)
                    or str(row.get("state", "")).upper() != "MERGED"):
                continue
            result.append(row | {
                "repository": {"name": repo, "nameWithOwner": f"matteocervelli/{repo}"},
                "url": row.get("url") or f"https://github.com/matteocervelli/{repo}/pull/{row['number']}",
                "title": row.get("title") or f"PR #{row['number']}",
                "closedAt": row.get("mergedAt", ""),
                "updatedAt": row.get("mergedAt", ""),
            })
    return result
